subject: Staggered billing for PO #HS-4821 — split payments and monthly statements
messages:

Subject: Initial ask: PO support for split payments and monthly billing

Hi Mina / Laura,

Thanks for the demo last week — team liked the performance numbers. Procurement asked me to loop you on a few requirements so we can get a PO over the finish line:

- HeartSync needs the PO to support split invoicing (we want to pay in three monthly invoices tied to go-live milestones).
- Preferred terms: Net 60.
- We typically require a monthly statement (electronic) and a single PDF invoice per month.
- Please confirm remit-to details and whether Redwood supports invoice delivery via your billing portal and email.

Attached is our PO template and a short spec of the fields procurement expects (HS-4821_PO_Spec.pdf). Two quick questions from procurement: any early-payment discounts, and do you accept billing in USD only?

If this is something you need to escalate, let me know who on your finance side I should work with. We’re hoping to issue a PO by Nov 18 if terms align.

Thanks,
Alex

Subject: Re: Initial ask: PO support for split payments and monthly billing

Hi Alex — good to hear from you and glad the demo landed well.

We can support staggered invoices tied to milestone events (onboarding, go-live, month 1 usage). Common split we see is 50% / 30% / 20%, but we can accept your three-month split as long as the milestones map to measurable delivery items.

On terms: our standard enterprise billing terms are Net 45. That said, for strategic customers we can accommodate Net 60 with a signed MSA and completed credit terms (ACH/credit form) — finance will want that in place before the first invoice is issued. As an alternative, we can offer a 2% discount on the first invoice if HeartSync can commit to a 30% upfront payment.

We bill in USD and can send invoices via email and make them available in the billing portal. I’m attaching the latest SOW and proposed milestone language to make mapping easier (SOW_HeartSync_v2.docx).

Laura — can you confirm whether we need any contract language to accept Net 60 and who should sign the ACH form?

Mina Haddad
Sr. Solutions & GTM | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.inference.com

Attachments: SOW_HeartSync_v2.docx

Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 10:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial ask: PO support for split payments and monthly billing

Thanks Mina — that helps. A couple clarifications from our payables team:

- Net 60 is preferable for HeartSync given internal approval cycles; if Redwood needs Net 45 we can discuss a bridge payment but procurement will push for Net 60.
- We require monthly invoicing tied to a calendar month (so first invoice on Dec 1 for onboarding/initial run).
- For pricing true-ups: if usage exceeds committed units in month 2, we will accept a mid-quarter true-up invoice; can you confirm how overage pricing would be handled?
- Our AP team prefers a single PDF invoice per month sent to payables@heartsync.com and uploaded to our finance portal.

I’m attaching our PO template for reference (HeartSync_PO_Template.docx). Can you confirm whether Redwood applies sales tax or if HeartSync is tax-exempt (we can provide exemption certificate if needed).

Alex

Attachment: HeartSync_PO_Template.docx

Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 08:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial ask: PO support for split payments and monthly billing

Hi Alex — looping in Rishi from finance to confirm operational details. Quick answers below: 

- Invoice schedule: we can emit one PDF invoice per calendar month to payables@heartsync.com and also post to the billing portal.
- Milestone mapping: please include the milestone acceptance criteria in the PO or a short exhibit so our billing team can auto-route invoice approvals.
- Net terms: Redwood standard is Net 45. We can accept Net 60 for first-year arrangements when (1) MSA is countersigned, (2) ACH/credit form is completed, and (3) we have an approved PO on file. We don’t typically add surcharges, but we do require the ACH/credit setup to be completed before shipping the first invoice under Net 60.
- Overage handling: overages are billed at the agreed overage rate in the SOW; we can also include a mid-quarter true-up invoice if that’s HeartSync’s preference.

Rishi — can you confirm whether Finance needs a credit approval or a PO number format to accept Net 60?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Billing Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.inference.com

We’ll issue the PO (HS-4821) by Nov 18.

A few final asks before PO:
- Confirm remit-to email for invoices: billing@redwood.inference.com?
- Confirm whether Redwood needs the tax exemption certificate before the first invoice or after PO issuance.
- Please confirm the overage unit price in writing so procurement can include it in the PO.

If those are good, we’ll route the PO and Finance will expect the first invoice on Dec 1.

Thanks — Alex
